name: Aman New York
insider_take: Where Gilded Age grandeur meets Aman's legendary serenity — right at the crossroads of Fifth Avenue and 57th Street.
whats_special: Aman New York occupies the historic Crown Building, a 1921 Fifth Avenue landmark crowned by its iconic gilded top. With just 83 ultra-private suites and one of NYC's largest spas at 25,000 sq ft, this is Manhattan luxury stripped of pretense. Aman's first North American urban property delivers the brand's signature stillness in the middle of the world's most electric city.
pro_tip: Reserve a table at the rooftop restaurant — the views stretching over Central Park are stunning at sunset, and the space feels worlds away from the Midtown buzz just below.
dont_miss: Descend into the hotel's Jazz Club, tucked within the building's original vaulted cellar. It's an intimate, atmospheric hideaway that channels old New York glamour with world-class live performances — a true secret gem hiding beneath Fifth Avenue.
pros: Exceptional luxury accommodations with spacious suites and residences
World-class Aman Spa with comprehensive wellness facilities
Prime Manhattan location with Central Park proximity
Signature Aman service excellence and attention to detail
